q1_issues.issue: "of that season" restricts the week, not the falling, yet it is attached as (Time sk_fall_1 sk_season_1) on a minted witness — a Time filler must be a structured term or a bare constant, and the instruction set bars minting an sk_ witness (or a Member atom) for a time.
(Every sk_fall_1 1 week) makes one fixed ~30-feather group recur weekly, whereas the sentence states a per-week rate over a different set of feathers each week.

(Cardinality sk_feather_2 (ParticleFromNormal 30 3)) puts a distribution into a slot the instruction set specifies as a native integer; the ParticleFromNormal form is defined for Measure magnitudes and clock values only.

the sealed complement omits the per-member distribution rule that a counted/vague plural with a distributive predicate ("several sky-cats ... molted") requires, although a seal must carry P's full normalized form including that rule.

q2_gaps: per-period base rate over a varying quantity ("about thirty feathers fall ... in a normal week") — the habitual Every/TimesPer forms bind one fixed group to one event; no per-occurrence quantity form is defined
approximate/hedged count ("about thirty feathers") — Cardinality's magnitude is a native integer and CardinalityPhrase is for phrases with no number
typicality qualifier on a frame adverbial ("in a normal week") — no licensed carrier, so the hedge is dropped
"at the same time" (simultaneity across several distributed events) — no licensed head; During needs two reified eventualities
anaphoric "that season" with no antecedent season in the text — term propagation has nothing to copy at that granularity
backward-shifted anaphoric time ("the previous night") — term propagation is defined for "that" and "the next/following", not for "previous/preceding"
ordinal/continuous day-count date ("day 705 of Year 2") — the Time terms assume a Gregorian Day-of-month inside a Month
notes: No CONTEXT block was supplied, so q3 is na. "No heavy sky-cat hunt had been seen" is encoded as an indefinite-witness denial; "no" is an explicit quantifier, and the instruction set does not settle whether a singular "no"-determiner subject takes that witness bundle or the strength-0 distributing rule with its QuantifierPhrase "no" companion.
